text_block_list.text:
Over the last few training sessions, Gold
City's
progress has been somewhat
stagnant.

Ugh, I just can't! How can I be this off
when I'm so
on point when modeling?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Wait... Maybe that's the key. I should
imagine I'm
on the runway.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
(It's like parading the final outfit at a
show. Gotta
make an impact with every
stЭпизод)
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
(A long stride to assert dominance. One
foot in
front of the other, no hesitation.)
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
(Give them a show with the turn. Sharp
and bold.
Center of gravity steady, no
faltering.)
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh... of course. Keeping full control over
my
movements is my specialty.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: If I keep that mentality when running...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, weren't there a few videos in
your office
explaining running form?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Show me all of them! There's something I
want to
try.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
(Arm swing needs to be more forceful...
My ankles
aren't absorbing the shock of
hitting the
ground...)
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
